drivers.evidence: No prior occurrence; no historical data. Novel, speculative driver. Noise-adjusted estimate shrunk toward 1.0. Plausible but unconfirmed.

adjustment.analysis: The baseline median is 207.6. The price is elevated by 5.1% (to $4.56), which historically has not driven uplift—past high-price weeks (2026-09-28, 2026-10-05) saw 195 and 119 units, respectively, both below baseline. The TikTok trend is a novel driver with no prior history; its effect is uncertain. No promotion, event, or seasonal ramp is active. The classical model suggests no lift, and recent high-price weeks show demand suppression. The noise-adjusted effect of past promotions (x1.36) is not applicable here—no promotion is happening. The planner note is speculative. No evidence supports a lift. The upside spread should remain at 1.0 unless a clear signal exists. Downside is plausible due to price increase and prior weak response at same price. Confidence is medium: one data point (TikTok) with no history, but price effect is consistent with suppression.
